Application Data.NAME: Art Haven Gallery
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Art Haven Gallery specializes in exhibiting and selling a diverse range of contemporary artworks, including paintings, sculptures, and mixed media pieces. The gallery also offers a curated selection of high-quality art supplies for both amateur and professional artists. We host regular workshops and events that emphasize safe handling of materials and provide necessary waivers for participants. Our facility is equipped with fire protection systems, secure storage for valuable artwork, and strict safety protocols to ensure a safe environment for both our staff and visitors. Additionally, we maintain insurance coverage for our public workshops and ensure all materials are handled safely and responsibly.
